description:
Candidate gene-editing targets for a trait in one pulse and legume genome: orthologues of Arabidopsis genes with
trait evidence (arabidopsis_trait_genes), ranked by score = Arabidopsis evidence x orthology weight (one2one 1,
one2many 0.6, many2many 0.4) / number of crop copies (redundant copies may all need editing). Gives the score
parts and flags. species: Ensembl genome (default pisum_sativum), e.g. 'pisum_sativum', 'glycine_max', 'vicia_faba'. Exploratory: pleiotropy is not
scored, and Arabidopsis function may not carry over; check expression (gene_expression) and variation
(panel_haplotypes) of the top genes.
name: editing_candidates
